question.worked_solution:
Interpreting the fractions as division, we get

$$
(15\,÷\,8)\times (24\,÷\,5).
$$

 

Since our expression contains multiplication and division only, we can create an equivalent expression by swapping the $÷\,8$ and $÷\,5:$

$$
(15\,÷\,5)\times (24\,÷\,8)
$$

 

Interpreting the divisions as fractions, we get

$$
\frac{15}{5}\times \frac{24}{8}.
$$

Carrying out the divisions, we arrive at

$$
\begin{aligned}{{\frac{15}{5}}_{⏟}}_{3}\times {{\frac{24}{8}}_{⏟}}_{3}=3\times 3=9.\end{aligned}
$$
